The '''CD-13z astrogator droid brain''' was an [[astrogation droid brain]] developed by [[GoCorp/Legends|GoCorp]] to complement [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]] systems. Installed directly into a ship’s [[Hull/Legends|hull]], it could perform [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] calculations on its own but was primarily intended to assist [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] or [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]]. While effective, the CD-13z was known to clash with other [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]], such as the [[CD-12a autopilot droid brain]], when both were present on the same vessel.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CD-13z astrogator droid brain was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
